$description: COMPONENT tokens for the selection controls. The box and thumb sizes are here rather than in the spacing scale for the same reason button heights are: they are the size of a control, not a rhythm, and a spacing change must not resize a checkbox.

default.$description: 20px. The visible checkbox and radio. The 44px target is restored as a hit area on coarse pointers rather than by growing the box.

height.$description: 24px track. Taller than a checkbox because the thumb has to sit inside it.

thumb.$description: 18px thumb, leaving 3px of track on every side.
